dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト), running on Linux with GnuCOBOL. Program ORCSNYUFTN handles inpatient co-payment calculation (負担金額算定サブ).
evidence: COPY count 34, CALL count 57 typical of ORCA subsystem
PIC clauses without COMP-3, consistent with GnuCOBOL ORCA style

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (receipt/レセプト) system — inpatient co-payment and room-charge calculation subroutine for the JMA ORCA standard receipt software
purpose.summary: ORCSNYUFTN is a subprogram within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that calculates patient co-payment amounts (負担金額算定) for inpatient (入院) claims. It handles various insurance combinations, room-charge differentials, elderly patient rules, and special local government supplements across multiple revision levels dating from 2002 to 2007.

notable_features: Large working-storage with OCCURS tables for insurance combination handling
Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1)
34 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
57 CALL statements to other ORCA subsystem programs
312 PERFORM statements with only 1 GOTO — structured programming style
No COMP-3 packed decimal despite financial calculations
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — file-less batch subprogram
Revision history spanning 2002–2007 with named developers (NACL team)
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP (Japanese) encoded, causing mojibake in the displayed text. Source is truncated to first 16000 chars; full file is 267KB / 5399 lines. Dialect identified as GnuCOBOL based on Linux target and JMA ORCA project context. Standard is effectively COBOL-85 with no observed 2002+ features.
